sloka: यथा सुनयनं वल्गु बिम्बोष्ठं चारुकुण्डलम् ।मुखं द्रक्ष्यसि रामस्य पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम् ।। ५.३६.३९।।।।
transliteration: yathā sunayanaṁ valgu bimboṣṭhaṁ cārukuṇḍalam ।mukhaṁ drakṣyasi rāmasya pūrṇacandramivoditam ।। 5.36.39।।।।

translations.english: "O Sita I swear in the name of mountains like Malaya, Vindhya, Meru, and Dardura (the abodes of monkeys and bears) and by the roots and fruits as well (which are the food of vanaras). you will soon behold Rama with beautiful eyes, red lips like bimba fruit, lovely earrings and a countenance resembling the full moon.
